# statusdrift_alert (Data Source)

Fetches a single alert by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the alert.

### Read-Only

- `conditions` (List of String) List of alert conditions.
- `delay_minutes` (Number) Delay in minutes before triggering the alert.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the alert is enabled.
- `max_recurrences` (Number) Maximum number of recurrences.
- `monitor_id` (Number) The ID of the monitor this alert belongs to.
- `notification_channel_ids` (List of Number) List of notification channel IDs.
- `notify_on_call` (Boolean) Whether this alert triggers the on-call escalation policy.
- `on_call_policy_id` (Number) On-call policy ID used for this alert.
- `recurring_interval_minutes` (Number) Recurring interval in minutes.
